title: Fine-tuning Multi-modal LLMs with ART: Art-based Reinforcement Training
abstract: arXiv:2606.11854v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specific tasks usually involves fine-tuning: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) edits the weights, while soft prompting prepends trainable virtual tokens. Both change how an already-optimized model is served, so serving many task-specific adapters at high throughput requires adapter-aware infrastructure. We propose Art-Based Reinforcement Training (ART), which optimizes a single auxiliary input image to specialize a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) for a specific task. At inference time, ART simply includes this image in each standard multimodal prompt, requiring no changes to the serving engine. We compare ART with LoRA and soft prompting across five reasoning benchmarks for four small MLLMs from three architectures. translated_title: 基于ART微调多模态大语言模型：基于艺术的强化训练
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）适配到特定任务通常涉及微调：低秩适应（LoRA）修改模型权重，而软提示则在输入前添加可训练的虚拟标记。这两种方法都会改变已经优化好的模型的部署方式，因此要以高吞吐量服务众多任务特定的适配器，需要具备适配器感知的基础设施。我们提出基于艺术的强化训练（ART），该方法通过优化单一辅助输入图像，使冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）专门化于特定任务。在推理时，ART只需将这张图像包含在每个标准多模态提示中，无需对推理引擎进行任何更改。我们在来自三种架构的四个小型MLLM上，跨五个推理基准测试，将ART与LoRA和软提示进行比较。虽然不同方法在不同任务上各有优势，但ART在20个基准-MLLM组合中有10个排名第一或第二，并在两个数学文字应用题基准上取得了最佳结果。
tldr: 提出ART方法，通过优化一张辅助输入图像使冻结的多模态大语言模型专门化于特定任务，无需修改推理引擎，在半数基准测试组合中超越LoRA和软提示方法。
en_tdlr: ART optimizes a single auxiliary input image to specialize frozen multimodal LLMs for specific tasks without modifying the serving engine, ranking first or second in half of the benchmark-MLLM pairs compared to LoRA and soft prompting.
